Careers and Culture

Our core values are the ideals, beliefs and principles that we stand for. They reflect our personality, shape our culture, and guide how we show up and engage with customers and each other.

How We Work at Salt

One team

Each team member plays a crucial role in our company’s success. We win as a team.

We are collaborative, transparent, aligned and always care about each other.

It’s all about our customers

We constantly adapt to exceed our customers expectations. We are their trusted partner.

Creating value is our reason for being.

Keep it positive.
Focus on the solution

We assume positive intent especially through difficult situations. 

We are respectful, professional and above all — focused on solving the problem.

Make it easy

We strive for simplicity in everything we do.

We make it easy for our customers and each other.

Move with speed. Get it done

Speed is a business strategy.

We own it, we are accountable and above all — we move fast and deliver with quality.

Join Us in Building What’s Next

We protect the APIs driving today’s innovation — and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Come help shape the future of security with us.
